sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United, currently top with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain the division's strongest performers and face one of the league's weakest sides — Alsager are bottom with just 4 points from 10 matches, having lost eight times and won only once this season.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to close the gap on Sandbach after their own recent loss. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a mid-table clash, while fourth-ranked Wolverhampton Casuals face Wednesfield Community at home. Bilston Town (6th) welcome Foley Meir in a lower-mid-table encounter. At the bottom, struggling Widnes Town visit Brereton Social, while Cheadle Heath Nomads away at Telford Town represents a battle between two of the division's poorest performers. Barnton host Shawbury United — Shawbury remain winless with five consecutive defeats — while Market Drayton Town travel to face New Mills. Crewe take on Allscott Heath in another fixture involving sides fighting near the lower reaches. Mid-week on Wednesday 7 October, Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community at 19:45, a rearranged fixture that keeps momentum-building opportunities alive late in the week.
